verdict.rationale: Gusto Business Compliance explicitly files state annual reports to keep good standing with the Secretary of State, across all 50 states [gusto-docs-22, gusto-docs-28, gusto-docs-31]. Proactive alerts flag upcoming annual-report deadlines and annual tax reminders [gusto-docs-21], and CPA Practice Advisor independently corroborates annual report filing [gusto-comm-1]. However, no evidence shows Gusto files franchise tax, only reminders, so half of the story rests on alerts rather than filing. Missing for 10: documented franchise tax filing or payment, and hands-on evidence of on-time filing outcomes.
